rollupMode.label: Parent Totals
rollupMode.description: How a parent row's income and expense relate to its children's

options.label: Computed - parent amounts are the sum of its children
Own + children - parent's own amounts are added to its children's sum
Budget cap - parent amounts are an allocation, children are shown against it

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Ordered column visibility, edited by the Columns tab rather than as a schema field

decimals.label: Decimal Places
decimals.description: How many decimal places amounts are shown and stored with. Entering more precision than this rounds to it. 0 gives whole-currency budgeting.

currency.label: Currency Code
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used to format amounts, e.g. USD, JMD

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: Locale used to format amounts, e.g. en-US, en-JM. Leave blank to use the system default.
